tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The infinite canvas ground and the top bar. Never used for cards.

tokens.name: canvas-dot
tokens.usage: Dot-grid marks on the canvas. Decorative only; must stay quieter than any card edge.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Session cards, menus, inputs at rest. All text tokens pass 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sidebar and popovers: the highest layer. In dark, elevation reads by this lighter step, not shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a panel: transcript preview, prompt editor, segmented control track.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost buttons, menu rows and chips.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline on cards, panels and the top bar.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered card edge, input borders, control outlines (3:1 against surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: card titles, sidebar headings, values.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: project path, metadata labels, status labels.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, counts, placeholders. On surface only, not canvas, in light.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Kingfisher teal. Selection ring, focus ring, primary button, active filter, highlighted cards. The only brand hue in the UI.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover / pressed.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (5.6:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for active chips, highlight halo, agent proposal well.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft (active filter chip label, proposal heading).

tokens.name: status-working
tokens.usage: Working dot + pulse. Always paired with the word 'Working'.

tokens.name: status-waiting
tokens.usage: Waiting / needs input. The one status that should pull the eye; paired with 'Needs input'.

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: Idle: drawn as a hollow ring so it differs by shape, not just colour.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Error dot and error text in the sidebar.

tokens.name: status-waiting-soft
tokens.usage: Pill background behind a Needs input label.

tokens.name: status-error-soft
tokens.usage: Pill background behind an Error label.

tokens.name: zone-sage
tokens.usage: Zone edge + label dot. Fill uses zone-sage-fill.

tokens.name: zone-sage-fill
tokens.usage: Zone body fill: barely there so cards stay the figure.

tokens.name: zone-sky
tokens.usage: Zone edge + label dot.

tokens.name: zone-sky-fill
tokens.usage: Zone body fill.

tokens.name: zone-sand
tokens.usage: Zone edge + label dot.

tokens.name: zone-sand-fill
tokens.usage: Zone body fill.

tokens.name: zone-rose
tokens.usage: Zone edge + label dot.

tokens.name: zone-rose-fill
tokens.usage: Zone body fill.

tokens.name: zone-iris
tokens.usage: Zone edge + label dot.

tokens.name: zone-iris-fill
tokens.usage: Zone body fill.

tokens.name: zone-slate
tokens.usage: Zone edge + label dot; the default for a new zone.

tokens.name: zone-slate-fill
tokens.usage: Zone body fill.

tokens.name: provider-claude
tokens.usage: Provider mark tile for Claude Code sessions.

tokens.name: provider-codex
tokens.usage: Provider mark tile for Codex sessions.

tokens.name: provider-gemini
tokens.usage: Provider mark tile for Gemini CLI sessions.

tokens.name: provider-opencode
tokens.usage: Provider mark tile for OpenCode sessions.

tokens.name: provider-cursor
tokens.usage: Provider mark tile for Cursor Agent sessions.

tokens.name: provider-copilot
tokens.usage: Provider mark tile for GitHub Copilot CLI sessions.

tokens.name: provider-other
tokens.usage: Provider mark tile for any adapter without its own accent (Grok, future).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Marquee selection fill and drop-target wash.

families.mono: "Geist Mono Variable", "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card title, zone name, button label.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Agent proposes to send a follow-up prompt.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Status label, relative time, metadata values. Use tabular numerals.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Tag chips, counts, section labels (uppercase only for section labels).

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Paths, cwd, session ids, resume commands. Nothing else.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row gap inside a card; panel inset from viewport edge.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding; top bar item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Sidebar padding; canvas dot-grid pitch at 100%.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sidebar sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Zone inner padding; auto-layout gutter between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Zone header offset; empty-state stack.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Auto-layout gap between project clusters.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Provider mark, kbd, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Session cards, proposal well.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Zones, sidebar, floating toolbars.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tag chips, status pills, zoom readout.

shadow.note: Light uses soft, two-layer shadows. Dark leans on surface steps and a hairline ring; shadows there are only for depth during drag.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Session card at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered card (paired with a 1px lift).

tokens.name: shadow-drag
tokens.usage: Card or selection while dragging.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Sidebar, popovers, floating canvas controls.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: card-width
tokens.usage: Session card width at 100% zoom. Height is content-driven (about 112px).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Sidebar width; resizable between 320 and 520px.

tokens.name: provider-mark
tokens.usage: Provider tile on cards; 28px in the sidebar header.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls.

tokens.name: opacity-dimmed
tokens.usage: Non-matching cards in Highlight filter mode.

tokens.name: opacity-ghost
tokens.usage: Drop ghost at the card's origin while dragging.

tokens.name: z-zone
tokens.usage: Zones sit under cards.

tokens.name: z-card
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: z-drag
tokens.usage: Card being dragged.

tokens.name: z-chrome
tokens.usage: Top bar, canvas controls, minimap.
